title: Diagnose the Link Failure
prompt: You are given (in the challenge text) two tiny sources: `a.c` declares and calls `int helper(void);` but never defines it; `b.c` defines `static int helper(void) { return 1; }`. Implement `int link_outcome(void)` returning the code for what linking `a.c` and `b.c` produces: 0 = links and helper returns 1, 1 = undefined reference at link time, 2 = multiple definition.

tests.name: static does not rescue extern use
tests.hint: b.c's helper is static — file-local, not exported — so a.c's call to helper stays undefined at link time.
